author: reek
body: Higher-order effect laundering. apply-pure declares a pure function parameter (Integer -> Integer). leaky is Integer -> [Console] Integer. Passing leaky where a pure function is required used to compile clean and RUN the I/O, because function-type unification stripped the effect row. The per-argument effect check now rejects it: the actual argument's Console effect is not permitted by the parameter's pure type (CDX2031).
